content: Fii Ahadi Heyri ndin e Nokkuure Hormorde Mawnde nden
Awa e hino nafa toɓɓere nde wonɗen yewtude fii mun nden: hiɗen mari wano oo *yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka ka Alla, jooɗiiɗo ka sengo ɲaamo jullere laamu Alla Mawɗo on ka kammuuli.
Ko o golloowo ka nder nokkuure hormorde, ɗun ko ka *rewirdu goongaaru, hara hinaa ndu yimɓe ɓen darni, kono ko Joomiraaɗo on.
Kala yottinoowo mawɗo ko toɗɗoraa ko fii weeɓitangol Alla dokke e sadakaaji, bee yottinoowo men mawɗo on kadi heɓa goɗɗun ko o weeɓita.
Si tawno himo ka hoore leydi, o wonataano yottinoowo sadaka, ɓay no woodi weeɓitooɓe dokke, hara ko no yaadiri e Sariya on.

Ɓen no waɗude dewal ngal tawata ko mbaadi e ɗowdi goongaaji kammuyankeeji ɗin, wano Muusaa ɓanginiranaa non fewndo ko o darnata rewirdu ndun, Alla daalani mo: «Ndaaru, a waɗiray fow noone no holliraɗaa non ka hoore fello.»
Kono jooni, *Almasiihu on heɓii golle ɓurɗe mawnude ɗe ɓeya ɗen, no o woniri non holnuɗo *ahadi ɓurndi moƴƴude ndin, sincaandi e fodaariiji ɓurɗi kelɗude ɗin.
Si tawno ahadi araniri ndin wonno ndi felnaaki, hewtataano ka wonndi ɗaɓɓee.
E hin-le ko e hoore feloore Alla daalani jamaa mun on: «Kanko Joomiraaɗo on o daali:

content.text: ndi mi ahodunoo e baabiraaɓe maɓɓe ɓen ndin,
wa fewndo mi tambitornoo ɓe juuɗe an ɗen
ko fii ɓe hunnaali ahadi an ndin.›
ndi mi ahodoyta e yimɓe Isra'iila ɓen
‹Mi waɗoyay sariyaaji an ɗin ka miijo maɓɓe,
mi winda ɗi ka ɓerɗe maɓɓe,
kamɓe kadi ɓe wona jamaa an.
maa fillitanagol wondiɗɗo mun maa musiɗɗo mun,

content: Ko fii mi yaafoyto ellaaji maɓɓe ɗin,

content.text: mi hakkilanoytaa e junuubaaji maɓɓe ɗin.› »

content: Ka o inni ndin ahadi heyri ɗon, ko ɗon o watti araniri ndin hinndi. E hin-le hinndi ndin nawyii, no e moggo mulugol.
